title: Teri Ummat Ney Teri Zehra (Sa) Ko
body:
Haaye Baba Haaye Baba x3
Teri Ummat Ney Teri Zehra Ko Hey Khoob Sataya Aey Baba x2
Har Lamha Rulaya Aey Baba x2
Har Dum Tadpaaya Aey Baba
1)-Haye Ajre Risalat Ummat Ne
Aey Baba Hame Kya Khoob Diya
Jis Dar Pa Farishte Jhukte The
Us Dar Ko Jalaya Aey Baba
2)-Tehreer Ke Tukde Kar Dale
Darbar Me Jhutlaya Mujhko
Baitha Hy Jo Teri Masnad Par
Usne Hee Rulaya Aey Baba
3)-Kya Zulm Hua Kaise Yeh Kaho
Meri Pasliya Toot Gayi Sari
Jab Aake Sitamgar Ney Jalta
Darwaza Giraya Aey Baba
4)-Ye Fatema Meri Madar Hai
Ye Dil Ka Tukda Hey Mere
Tere Qol Ko Ummat Ne Haye
Tere Baad Bhulaya Aey Baba
5)-Meri Pasliyaa'n Tooti Ghar Bhi Jala
Mohsin Ko Mere Maar Diya
Aur Baandh Ke Gardan Me Rassi
Haider Ko Phiraya Aye Baba
6)-Jis Waqt Qale Ko Haider Ke
Bandha Gaya Rassi Se Baba
Maine Hi Sitamgar Se Us Dam
Aakar Ke Chudaya Aey Baba
7)-Mara Hai Mere Mohsin Ko
Be-Dard Sitamgar Ne Aa Kar
Is Sadme Ne Haaye Mujhko
Reh Reh Ke Rulaya Aye Baba
8)-Jeene Bhi Nahi Dete Mujhko
Rone Bhi Nahi Dete Mujhko
Bewajha Sazaye Hum Ko Mili
Hey Kaisi Riaa Ya Hai Baba
9)-Mera Haq Chheena Mohsin Chheena
Darwaza Jalakar Tod Diya
Is Par Na SukooÃ± Jab Unko Mila
Mera Rauza Giraya Aye Baba
10)-Jag Bhul Na Paye Ghum Mera
Is Waste Maine "Aasif" Ko
Alfaz Ataa Kar Key Us Se
Nauha Likhwaya Aey Baba
